question.nlq: Could you tell me which staff members have handled complaints for all product categories?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the staff members who have handled complaints for every product category, i.e., those who have dealt with each category at least once.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_code)
    FROM Products p
) = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pp.product_category_code)
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products pp ON c.product_id = pp.product_id
    WHERE c.staff_id = s.staff_id
);

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean, for each product category, list the staff members who have handled complaints for that category.
meanings.gt_sql: SELECT p."product_category_code", c."staff_id" FROM "Complaints" c JOIN "Products" p ON c."product_id" = p."product_id" GROUP BY p."product_category_code", c."staff_id" ORDER BY p."product_category_code", c."staff_id";

answers.text: I mean staff members who have each handled complaints for every product category.

SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Products p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Complaints c
        JOIN Products pc ON c.product_id = pc.product_id
        WHERE c.staff_id = s.staff_id
        AND pc.product_category_code = p.product_category_code
    )
);

SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_code) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_code) FROM Products);

SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_code) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_code) FROM Products);

WITH total_categories AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_code) AS cnt
    FROM Products
),
staff_categories AS (
    SELECT c.staff_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_code) AS cnt
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.staff_id
)
SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Staff s
JOIN staff_categories sc ON s.staff_id = sc.staff_id
JOIN total_categories tc ON sc.cnt = tc.cnt;
